clean_repro.probe: POST /collections/c/points/count with exact:true vs exact:false using is_empty condition on indexed keyword field
clean_repro.observed: exact:true returned count=2, exact:false returned count=1, scroll ground truth confirmed 2 points with empty kw field
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:6333/collections/c/points/count -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"exact": true, "filter": {"must": [{"is_empty": {"key": "kw"}}]}}' && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:6333/collections/c/points/count -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"exact": false, "filter": {"must": [{"is_empty": {"key": "kw"}}]}}'

verified_assumptions: Keyword index was successfully created on field 'kw'
Collection contains both points with kw='red' and points without kw field (empty)
exact=true performs full scan and returns accurate count
exact:false should use index estimation but returns different (incorrect) count

contract_refs: constraint_id: qdrant_cardinality_oracle_count-exact-false - count API's approximate cardinality path uses index-based estimation
parameter: exact (boolean) - true=accurate scan count, false=approximate indexed cardinality estimate

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: CountRequest(exact:false) → EdgeShard::count → estimate_point_count → condition_cardinality → IsEmpty condition → estimate_field_condition → MapIndex::estimate_cardinality → estimate_cardinality_impl → returns None (fallback to unknown estimation)
source_grounding.note: Source code接地发现: MapIndex的estimate_cardinality_impl函数只处理Match条件(Match::Value/Match::Any/Match::Except)，对IsEmpty/IsNull条件返回None。当返回None时，调用方fallback到CardinalityEstimation::unknown，这导致近似计数与精确计数不一致。

falsification.probe: Scroll with same is_empty filter returns ground truth count
falsification.observed: Scroll returned 2 points (id=1, id=6) with empty payload {}, confirming exact=true count=2 is accurate. The approximate count=1 is incorrect.

excluded: Environment issue - running on standard qdrant v1.18.3 container
Request parameter typo - using exact boolean parameter correctly
API semantics misunderstanding - exact:true/false have documented meanings
By-design fallback - documented behavior expects accurate estimation

cognition_match.developer_quote: Cardinality Oracle mismatch on count API exact:false (indexed approximate path). count(exact:false)=N but count(exact:true)=M and scroll with same filter returns M points; |N-M| exceeds tolerated estimation error (>20% OR systematic one-directional drift across collection sizes).
cognition_match.note: Matches known bug shape qdrant-cardinality-oracle-count-exact-false: is_empty condition on indexed field shows divergence between exact:true scan (2) and exact:false indexed estimate (1), with scroll ground truth confirming 2. Error rate: 50% exceeds tolerated 20% threshold.

verdicts.rationale: qdrant_018 CONFIRMED: Cardinality estimation bug in MapIndex (keyword field) for IsEmpty condition when exact=false. Source code接地发现 estimate_cardinality_impl 只处理Match条件，IsEmpty条件返回None导致fallback到CardinalityEstimation::unknown。实测证实: exact:true=2 (准确), exact:false=1 (错误), scroll真值=2。误差50%超过容忍阈值20%。符合bug_shapes.json中的qdrant-cardinality-oracle-count-exact-false模式。
